title: Getting the unknown onto one side

ask.text: Author a claim on this site that closes at 3.

hints.text: Tare on the near pan, contents on the far. Rell's balance, and it is level.
The far pan is the site. You are authoring the near one.
Whatever you write, seating 3 has to leave the Sill level.

worldFraming.text: Take contents off both until only one pan holds any.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: Tare on the near pan, contents on the far. Rell's balance, and it is level.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.

worldFraming.text: Contents on both pans — the same contents, because it is the same stray in both sockets.
